about: Krish's approval of the engine change for the Fri 20 Nov piece (c00cd4e0): the pillar staging for his vertical long take, kinetic_stat kept cream on a dark ground, no mark over a real page, the push camera keeping a graphics-only region in frame, the optional dated call. velib/guards.py reads it beside the spec's approvals; scope engine waives nothing else. If the engine changes again before this piece renders, the hash no longer matches and he is asked again.

approvals.said: yes change for all moving forward - but bear in mind that the audio waveform visual behind it was made for a piece about AI music specifically. In the future, the engine needs to find its own visual that matches the piece.
approvals.covers: the house title card over the piece's own picture (no music bars); a SPLIT panel draws its beat's backdrop, so no plain black panel (his rule of 19 Nov: 'I don't want a plain black screen anywhere')

approvals.asked: one more change to the title card: a soft dark panel behind the MAKE YOUR MIND/UP wordmark so it stays readable over the moving pictures

approvals.said: fix all five, this is absolute madness
approvals.covers: the post-render Critic's five fixes he ordered: a slam word fades fully on exit (no 'TEAMSS' residue); the slam tapes run off both frame edges; the title wordmark sits tight under the bands as one lockup; a caption page never spans the title moment; an object may be placed on any layout and a plate-none beat draws its backdrop, so the slam band sits above his head on a full-face beat
